WITH circuit_counts AS (
  SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count
  FROM races
  GROUP BY circuitId
), shares AS (
  SELECT circuitId,
         race_count,
         1.0 * race_count / SUM(race_count) OVER () AS share,
         1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM circuit_counts
), ranked AS (
  SELECT circuitId,
         race_count,
         share,
         share - average_share AS excess_share,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share - average_share DESC) AS excess_rank
  FROM shares
)
SELECT circuitId,
       race_count,
       share,
       excess_share
FROM ranked
WHERE share > 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circuit_counts)
  AND excess_rank <= 10
ORDER BY excess_share DESC

assumptions.assumption: Each race has a non-NULL circuitId; the average share is across circuit IDs represented in races.
